recommendation: Keep the core no-change audit. If the Additional Resources publication or another external package needs guidance for MedicationRequest orders based on ImmunizationRecommendation, address it in that owning package or through a new work-group decision rather than restoring a removed core targetProfile.
issue_request: FHIR-19108 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Pharmacy change request to let MedicationRequest.basedOn reference ImmunizationRecommendation so an immunization order could be linked to a CDS-generated recommendation.
initial_application: Jira comments cite merge commit 65133c5c9a9c6b94e85467b69529239812f98374. The underlying implementation commit 0bb03b10227fcb96af6082ce397cb70db55c1551 added ImmunizationRecommendation to the old MedicationRequest.basedOn spreadsheet reference list, and that target survived later source conversion until the 2025 resource-removal work.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is still active in source/fhir.ini, but ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation have no active current-build core resource entries. Public Health WG minutes on 2025-10-02 approved making both ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation Additional Resources in R6 until further maturity, and commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 then removed the resource source directories and the MedicationRequest.basedOn ImmunizationRecommendation targetProfile. Later same-element issue FHIR-47858 rejected adding PlanDefinition to basedOn and added protocol guidance instead.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding ImmunizationRecommendation to source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml would now point to a resource outside the active core build and would reverse the later PHWG R6 Additional Resources decision.

related_jiras.note: Added RequestOrchestration to the same MedicationRequest.basedOn target list before the later removal of ImmunizationRecommendation.
Considered another requested basedOn target and reaffirmed that basedOn points to request resources, adding protocol guidance instead of PlanDefinition as a target.
Resolved no-change and cited the then-current basedOn target list, including ImmunizationRecommendation, while recommending supportingInformation for MedicationStatement.

evidence_items.summary: Current MedicationRequest.basedOn targets CarePlan, MedicationRequest, ServiceRequest, and RequestOrchestration, with no ImmunizationRecommendation targetProfile.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationRequest remains active in the current build, while ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation have no active core resource entries.
evidence_items.learned: A core targetProfile to ImmunizationRecommendation would now reference a resource outside the active core build.

evidence_items.summary: The 2025 commit removed ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation source directories and removed ImmunizationRecommendation from MedicationRequest.basedOn.
evidence_items.learned: The current omission follows a broad resource removal rather than an isolated missed application of FHIR-19108.

evidence_items.learned: This later work-group decision explains why the old core reference target should not be restored in current core source.
